Ulta Beauty does not currently offer a public developer API, but provides an affiliate program through Impact for publishers and content creators.

providers.name: Ulta Salon, Cosmetics & Fragrance
providers.description: Ulta Salon, Cosmetics & Fragrance (now operating as Ulta Beauty) is the largest beauty retailer in the United States, offering cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products, and salon services through retail stores and online. This entry tracks the legacy brand identity prior to the Ulta Beauty rebranding. No public developer API is currently available.

providers.name: ACTIVON Co., Ltd.
providers.description: ACTIVON Co., Ltd. (엑티브온) is a South Korean green-biotechnology materials company founded in 2009 and headquartered in Suwon, Gyeonggi-do, that develops and manufactures cosmetic ingredients and micro-encapsulation technology — skin-safe preservative alternatives, multifunctional actives, emollients, humectants and bio-converted ingredients — alongside functional pigment lines (EnergiON heat-storage, Thermon thermochromic, Photon, Fragron, Memorion, MultiON) sold into textiles, coatings, plastics and cosmetics. It is a specialty-materials manufacturer, not a software vendor: it publishes no developer portal, no API reference and no machine-readable API contract. Its only machine-readable agent surface is the Wix-platform site MCP endpoint and llms.txt served on its corporate site, both probed live by API Evangelist.

providers.name: Eyva
providers.description: Eyva (operated by datazeit GmbH of Cologne, Germany) is an AI-powered portfolio-intelligence platform for the beauty and personal-care industry. It unifies consumer, market, and product data so product, marketing, and R&D teams can detect emerging consumer trends across Google search, TikTok, Instagram, and product reviews, benchmark their portfolio, run gap and competitive analysis, track ingredients and claims, and develop AI-assisted product concepts. The platform bundles an AI research assistant, automated AI reporting, and data-backed product recommendations, and is used by 700+ teams at brands including Beiersdorf, Nivea, dm, BASF, Babor, and Lavera. Eyva is a portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital. It is a B2B SaaS delivered through a demo-led sales motion and an authenticated web application; no public developer API surface is currently published.

providers.name: Ephemeral Solutions
providers.description: Ephemeral Solutions is the company entity behind Ephemeral Tattoo, the direct-to-consumer brand at ephemeraltattoos.com (ephemeral.tattoo) known for "made-to-fade" semi-permanent tattoos applied with a vegan ink formulated to fade naturally over roughly one to three years, removing the need for laser removal. The company operates two sides of a marketplace: a consumer service that connects people with approved partner tattoo artists, and a business line that sells its proprietary fading ink to professional tattoo artists and studios. It runs an editorial blog, a lookbook of tattoo examples, a How It Works explainer, and an FAQ. It was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio lead. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or agent surface, so this profile carries only verified identity and domain-security signals.

providers.name: The Estée Lauder Companies
providers.description: The Estée Lauder Companies Inc. (NYSE: EL) is one of the world's leading manufacturers, marketers and sellers of quality prestige skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products. Founded in 1946 by Estée and Joseph Lauder, the family-controlled, New York-headquartered conglomerate operates a portfolio of more than 20 prestige brands sold in approximately 150 countries and territories, employs roughly 57,000 people worldwide, and reported fiscal 2025 net sales of approximately $14.32 billion. ELC's corporate website (elcompanies.com) does not expose any public developer APIs, OpenAPI specs, SDKs, sandboxes, or a developer portal — the EsteeLauder GitHub organization is empty of public repositories. The technology surface is instead expressed through enterprise partnerships: the AI Innovation Lab (announced 2023, expanded April 2024) jointly run with Microsoft on Azure OpenAI Service; the ConsumerIQ tool built on Microsoft Copilot Studio (2025); an Adobe Firefly Services generative AI collaboration for digital marketing assets (March 2025); a Google Gemini / Vertex AI–powered Jo Malone London Scent Advisor (December 2025); and a Shopify-based unified global direct-to-consumer commerce platform (announced October 2025, ~50% rolled out by calendar year-end 2026). ELC's strategic vision, "Beauty Reimagined" (announced February 2025), and the Profit Recovery and Growth Plan ($0.8–1.0B gross benefits; $1.2–1.6B restructuring charges) anchor the One ELC operating model now led by CEO Stéphane de La Faverie and Board Chair William P. Lauder.

providers.name: Coty
providers.description: Coty Inc. is one of the world's largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin and body care. The company operates two divisions: Prestige (premium fragrance, cosmetics, and skincare brands such as Gucci, Burberry, Calvin Klein, Hugo Boss, Marc Jacobs, Tiffany, Chloe, Davidoff, Lancaster, philosophy, and Kylie Cosmetics) and Consumer Beauty (mass-market color cosmetics, hair care, and body care brands such as CoverGirl, Rimmel, Max Factor, Sally Hansen, Bourjois, and Adidas). Coty does not publish a public developer API; supplier and partner integrations occur through the Coty Supplier Portal and B2B / EDI channels.

providers.name: FabFitFun
providers.description: FabFitFun is a members-only lifestyle subscription company that delivers curated seasonal boxes of full-size beauty, fashion, wellness, and home products from premium brands, plus a members' community, customization, and weekly flash-sale shopping. Founded in Los Angeles and backed by 500 Global, Bond Capital, and Kleiner Perkins, FabFitFun serves over one million members with seasonal boxes valued up to $350 for as low as $65 per season. The company operates a direct-to-consumer commerce website, a members' account and box-customization experience, a support/help center, and the FabFitFun Magazine content property. As of this profile FabFitFun publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or API reference; this entry captures its public web and legal surface plus a probed domain-security posture, and remains a portfolio-sourced lead for further enrichment.

providers.name: THG
providers.description: THG plc (formerly The Hut Group) is a UK-based consumer brands group founded in 2004 in Manchester and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Following the 2025 demerger of its Ingenuity technology and fulfilment division, THG is a pure-play consumer brands business operating two divisions: THG Beauty (home to Lookfantastic, Cult Beauty, Dermstore and prestige brand partners) and THG Nutrition (led by Myprotein, one of the world's largest online sports-nutrition brands). THG designs, manufactures and sells beauty and nutrition products direct-to-consumer across global markets. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Balderton Capital, an early investor. THG operates corporate, investor-relations and careers web properties but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: Amyris
providers.description: Amyris, Inc. is a synthetic-biology and precision-fermentation company that engineers microbes to convert plant-derived sugars into high-performance renewable molecules — including farnesene, squalene, squalane, and bisabolol — at industrial scale. The company offers strain development, process development, piloting, scale-up, and manufacturing services for custom renewable chemistry used across personal care, cosmetics, flavors and fragrances, and other industries, emphasizing resilient supply chains, product consistency, and reduced ecological impact. Amyris is a private company that emerged from a 2023 Chapter 11 restructuring; it does not currently publish a public developer API or technology platform.

providers.name: A-Frame
providers.description: A-Frame Brands is a Los Angeles-based consumer brand incubator and product-development company founded in 2019 by entrepreneur Ari Bloom and actor Hill Harper. It partners with celebrities and cultural figures to build purpose-driven personal-care, beauty, fragrance, home-care, and pet-care brands, taking each from opportunity identification through product development, design, sourcing, production, and retail go-to-market. Brands in its portfolio include LOVED01 (John Legend), Kinlo (Naomi Osaka), Proudly (Gabrielle Union and Dwyane Wade), and Purrfect Paws, sold through retailers such as Target, Walmart, Amazon, CVS, JCPenney, QVC, and Bath & Body Works. Backed by Initialized Capital. This is a consumer company profile in the API Evangelist network; A-Frame publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: GlamSt
providers.description: GlamSt (GlamST LLC) builds customized virtual makeover and try-on solutions for beauty brands and retailers, combining augmented reality (AR), artificial intelligence, and machine learning to power virtual makeup and cosmetics try-on across mobile, web, and in-store experiences. Founded with offices in San Francisco, Montevideo (Uruguay), and Wilmington (Delaware), the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. GlamSt was acquired by Ulta Beauty in 2018 and integrated into Ulta's digital innovation team; it exposes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface, so this profile is identity-only.

providers.name: Belk
providers.description: Belk is a privately-held American department store chain headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, serving the southeastern United States. The company sells clothing, handbags, jewelry, beauty products, and home goods. Belk operates an omnichannel retail model with physical stores and an online marketplace. Supplier and marketplace integrations are handled via EDI through value-added networks, with order management integration available through Rithum (formerly CommerceHub) and other channel management platforms.

providers.name: Avon Products
providers.description: Avon Products is a global manufacturer and marketer of beauty and related products, primarily distributed through a network of independent sales representatives.

providers.name: Bota Biosciences
providers.description: Bota Biosciences (Bota Bio, 恩和科技) is an industrial and synthetic biology company that applies AI-driven computation and laboratory automation to bio-manufacturing. Its in-house Bota Biofoundry and Cell2Cloud platforms combine computational algorithms, non-model industrial strain engineering, rapid iterative enzyme engineering and performance protein design to shorten design-build-test-learn cycles, and in March 2026 it launched SAION AI, a three-layer "Physical AI" platform (cognition, orchestration, execution) that drives laboratory hardware through a proprietary Biological Protocol Language. Bota commercializes this work as physical ingredients rather than software: Purtect bio-preservatives (nisin, natamycin, ε-poly-lysine, lysozyme), Prorylia biomimetic proteins and Re² Coffea Arabica peptides, sold through its HeliaGenesis food and nutrition brand and its YuccaElements personal care brand, with partnerships including BASF, Proya, Syensqo and Puratos. Founded in 2019 with operations in Hangzhou, China and the San Francisco Bay Area, Bota publishes no developer portal, no public API documentation, no SDKs and no machine-readable specification; its computational software is internal laboratory tooling and its SAION AI application is reachable only through a login with an administrator-managed account whitelist.

providers.name: Sephora
providers.description: Sephora is a French multinational chain of personal care and beauty stores and a subsidiary of LVMH, operating 2,700+ locations worldwide and a large ecommerce footprint. Sephora does not publish a public developer API and does not maintain a public GitHub organization. The Sephora storefront and Beauty Insider loyalty program are accessed only through consumer apps and the website; affiliate marketing partnerships are brokered through third-party networks such as Rakuten Advertising and Skimlinks rather than a Sephora-owned API.

providers.name: Achats Group
providers.description: Achats Group (아샤그룹) is a South Korean media-commerce company founded in February 2017 and led by CEO Vivian Eun Young Lee, with offices in Pangyo (Seongnam) and Magok (Seoul). It manufactures and sells everyday consumer goods — sanitizing and deodorizing sprays, foot care, living care, health drinks and cosmetics — under its own brands Cellomon, ND247 / Neverdie, Biotreat and BringB, marketing them through short-form video and social advertising that routes buyers into its own Cafe24 storefronts and a Naver Smart Store. Public records put total funding near USD 6.2 million through a Series B. It is a direct-to-consumer consumer-goods business, not a software vendor: as of 2026-09-06 achatsgroup.co.kr is a Cafe24-hosted brochure site still carrying unedited pages from its purchased template, with no developer portal, no API documentation, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract, and the brand storefronts are hosted Cafe24 malls whose only /api path is Cafe24's own.

providers.name: Ipsy
providers.description: IPSY is a personalized beauty subscription company founded in 2011 by Michelle Phan, Marcelo Camberos, and Jennifer Goldfarb. Members take a detailed beauty quiz and receive monthly curated "Glam Bag" drops of deluxe samples and full-size makeup, skincare, hair, and fragrance products across tiers (Original, Boxycharm, and Ultimate). IPSY operates as a direct-to-consumer commerce and membership platform under the BFA Industries umbrella; it exposes no public developer API, running on internal GraphQL and REST services with Auth0-based consumer identity. This API Evangelist profile tracks IPSY's public web, security, and identity surface rather than a documented developer program.

providers.name: Preemadonna
providers.description: Preemadonna is a consumer hardware and software company best known for the Nailbot, a compact inkjet nail-art printer that prints custom designs onto fingernails, press-ons, gel, or bare nails in about five seconds. Backed by Version One Ventures, the company is building a creative-expression platform that pairs smart hardware with AI-powered design tools, consumables, and a creator marketplace, delivered through companion iOS and Android apps. The company holds 10+ utility patents. Preemadonna currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web, support, and policy footprint for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Styleseat
providers.description: StyleSeat is an online booking and business-management marketplace for beauty and grooming professionals — hair stylists, barbers, nail technicians, estheticians, and other independent service providers. Professionals use StyleSeat to publish a bookable profile, manage their calendar and appointments, accept online payments and deposits, reduce no-shows, and market their services, while clients discover local pros, browse portfolios and reviews, and book appointments online. Founded in 2011 and based in San Francisco, StyleSeat operates as a consumer-facing web and mobile platform. It currently exposes no public developer API or partner API program; this profile was surfaced as a venture-portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline with domain-security and public-property signals.

providers.name: Purplle
providers.description: Purplle is an Indian beauty and personal care e-commerce marketplace headquartered in Mumbai, founded in 2012 by Manish Taneja, Rahul Dash, Suyash Katyayani and Anurag Neema. The platform sells skincare, makeup, haircare, fragrance, bath and body, grooming, mom and baby and wellness products across India, carrying a catalogue of 60,000+ products from 1,000+ brands alongside its own homegrown labels — Good Vibes, DERMDOC, Alps Goodness, NY Bae, FACES CANADA, Carmesi, Salm Skin and Juicy Chemistry. Purplle became an Indian unicorn in 2022 and is backed by ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Peak XV Partners, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, JSW Ventures and Blume Ventures. It operates a consumer website and mobile app plus 100+ offline stores, and publishes editorial guidance through Purplle Magazine. Purplle is a direct-to-consumer retailer: as of this profile it publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract. It does publish an llms.txt at its web root describing its catalogue for AI agents.

providers.name: Y&S
providers.description: Y&S is the company behind ReservaTurno, an Argentine consumer appointment-booking platform (active circa 2014-2023) that let users reserve turnos at hair salons, beauty and aesthetics centers via web and mobile apps, and gave centers a free online agenda and client-communication system. It is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of 2026-07-21 the website returns 404 on all pages and no public API or developer surface was found.

providers.name: GoWabi
providers.description: GoWabi is a Bangkok-based beauty and wellness booking marketplace serving Thailand and selected markets across Southeast Asia. Consumers use its web and mobile apps to discover and book more than 5,000 spas, massage studios, beauty clinics, nail, hair, dental, fitness, and wellness providers, with discounted deals, cashback rewards, and multiple payment options (credit card, Alipay, BNPL). GoWabi also offers a B2B SaaS/CRM tool integrated with partner point-of-sale systems to help salons, spas, clinics, and studios manage bookings and operations. It is backed by 500 Global. GoWabi operates a private mobile app backend (mobile-api.gowabi.com) but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or portal at this time.

providers.name: Prose
providers.description: Prose is a New York City-based direct-to-consumer beauty company that makes truly custom haircare and skincare. Customers complete an online consultation covering hair type, scalp, lifestyle, diet, and local environment, and Prose then formulates personalized shampoo, conditioner, hair masks, supplements, and skincare made to order and sold primarily through a subscription model. Prose was surfaced as a portfolio company of forerunner-ventures and insight-partners. It operates no public developer API; its verified GitHub organization publishes internal tooling and third-party client libraries only, so this profile carries company identity and a domain-security probe rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: ScentBird
providers.description: Scentbird is a New York City-based monthly fragrance subscription service, founded in 2014 and backed by 500 Global and Y Combinator. Members receive a travel-size (8ml) designer fragrance each month for a flat subscription fee, selecting from a rotating catalog of hundreds of designer and niche perfume and cologne brands, and can also purchase full-size bottles, candles, and beauty products through the direct-to-consumer storefront. Scentbird operates as a consumer e-commerce and subscription brand; its public engineering presence is a GitHub organization of internal tooling and open-source forks (data-integration taps, shipping-API clients, Grails plugins), and it does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

providers.name: afujingyou
providers.description: afujingyou (阿芙 / AFU) is a Chinese consumer essential-oil, aromatherapy and skincare brand founded in 2006, backed by Qiming Venture Partners (Series C, 2017). It sells single and blended essential oils, base/carrier oils, masks, emulsions and face creams through retail and e-commerce channels (Tmall/JD/Weibo storefronts). Enrichment finding (2026-07-17): this is a consumer packaged-goods brand, not an API provider — no public developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or other API artifacts exist to harvest, and the catalog domain afujingyou.net.cn does not resolve (NXDOMAIN). Retained as an identity-only record; no API artifacts are applicable.

providers.name: BeautyDate
providers.description: BeautyDate (beautydate.com.br) is a Brazilian beauty and wellness marketplace that connects consumers with salons and independent beauty professionals for discovering and booking appointments online. It was surfaced as a 500 Global venture-portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. At the time of this enrichment pass the public website and application endpoints were unreachable (HTTP 530 behind Cloudflare, with api.beautydate.com.br redirecting to a down app.beautydate.com.br origin), so no developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable specification could be captured.

providers.name: Bolt Threads
providers.description: Bolt Threads, Inc. was a San Francisco Bay Area biomaterials company founded in 2009 to engineer protein- and mycelium-based materials. It is best known for Microsilk, a bioengineered spider-silk fiber; Mylo, a mycelium-derived leather alternative developed with partners including adidas, Kering, Lululemon, Patagonia and Stella McCartney; and b-silk protein, a silk-protein ingredient for beauty and personal care. The company went public on Nasdaq in August 2024 via a SPAC business combination under the ticker BSLK, halted Mylo production, was suspended from Nasdaq in January 2026, and now trades OTC Pink while deregistering with the SEC. Its website serves only a notice that the company is no longer operating. Bolt Threads was a materials manufacturer, not a software vendor, and never operated a developer program, public API, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Dollar Shave Club
providers.description: Dollar Shave Club is a direct-to-consumer men's grooming brand founded in 2011 and best known for its subscription razor and blade service that ships razors, blades, shave butter, and personal-care products to members on a recurring schedule. Acquired by Unilever in 2016 and later sold to Nexus Capital Management in 2023, the company sells online through its storefront at dollarshaveclub.com. Its e-commerce experience runs on Shopify; the storefront host exposes Shopify Customer Account OAuth2/OIDC discovery documents (including Shopify's customer-account-api and customer-account-mcp-api scopes) but Dollar Shave Club publishes no first-party public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation of its own. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub of a16z, Cowboy Ventures, Dragoneer, and Forerunner Ventures.

providers.name: Effa
providers.description: Effa is a sustainable consumer goods company that makes the world's first 100% recyclable paper toothbrush, a disposable, plastic-free alternative to conventional plastic toothbrushes aimed at hotels, airlines, and retail consumers. Founded in Ukraine by Dasha and Ilya Kichuk and headquartered in San Francisco, California, the company supplies eco-friendly personal care and amenity products to hospitality and travel clients, with reported customers including Netflix and Radisson. Effa is backed by 500 Global and Startup Wise Guys. Effa does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification; this profile tracks the company for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Eve Com
providers.description: Eve.com was a dot-com era e-commerce retailer of prestige beauty and personal care products, founded in 1998 by Mariam Naficy and Varsha Rao. It raised venture funding from Lightspeed Venture Partners (1999) and reached a Series B before being acquired by Idealab in 2000, after which the business ceased independent operations. It is retained in the API Evangelist network only as a historical Lightspeed portfolio lead; it published no developer program, API, SDKs, or documentation. The eve.com domain is today operated by an unrelated entity (CCP Games / the EVE Online game universe) and is not a surface for this company, so no live API or developer artifacts can be harvested for it.

providers.name: Glo Pharma
providers.description: GLO Pharma is a beauty and aesthetics company developing next-generation products for at-home use, best known for the subtopical skincare brand Ourself. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners (Series A, 2020), the company operates as a direct-to-consumer beauty and personal-care business rather than a technology or API provider: it sells physical skincare and aesthetic products to end consumers and does not publish a developer platform, public API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Lightspeed portfolio company profile; enrichment found no API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Good Glamm Group
providers.description: Good Glamm Group is an India-based content-to-commerce conglomerate in the personal care and cosmetics sector, founded in September 2021 by Darpan Sanghvi, Priyanka Gill, and Naiyya Saggi and briefly valued as a unicorn after 2021 Series D funding. Its house of brands includes MyGlamm, St.Botanica, The Moms Co, Sirona, Organic Harvest, POPxo, ScoopWhoop, BabyChakra, MissMalini, and Tweak, spanning India, Dubai, Singapore, and the USA. The group was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and Prosus Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the goodglamm.com domain serves a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) stakeholder portal, and no public developer API or documentation surface was found.

providers.name: Herbeast
providers.description: Herbeast is a sustainable skin care and lifestyle brand based in China, backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. The company explores the application of Chinese herbal essence to the skin, grounding its formulations in the concepts and technical principles of biomedicine. Founded and led by CEO Yisa He with Chief Scientist and co-founder Yanjing Bai, Herbeast operates as a consumer skin care and lifestyle products brand rather than an API-first technology provider. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; its only observed web property (herbeast.com) resolves to a deactivated Shopify storefront. It is retained in the API Evangelist network as a Lightspeed portfolio identity record, not as an active API producer.

providers.name: L Brands
providers.description: L Brands was a Fortune 500 specialty retail holding company best known for Victoria's Secret, PINK, and Bath & Body Works. In 2021 the company split into two independent publicly traded companies, with Bath & Body Works, Inc. retaining the original NYSE listing and Victoria's Secret & Co. spun off as a standalone retailer. The L Brands brand is no longer in active use; this repository preserves the historical corporate record. No public developer API has been documented.

providers.name: Lyracollective
providers.description: Lyra Collective is a consumer-products holding company that owns and operates a portfolio of everyday care brands across skincare, feminine care, and family and pet products, including LOLA, EVER, QRX Labs, TriLASTIN, Nuvadermis, Natemia, Leash Boss, and Lusso Gear. It positions itself around "Exceptional Care, For Everyday Moments," emphasizing clean, quality essentials sold direct-to-consumer and through retail. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer-brands operator it publishes no public developer portal, API, or API documentation; there is no API surface to enrich.

providers.name: Madison-reed
providers.description: Madison Reed is a female-founded and female-led direct-to-consumer hair color company offering 8-Free permanent, demi-permanent, and root touch-up hair color crafted in Italy, sold as at-home kits and delivered as professional services at 95+ Hair Color Bar locations across the United States. The company blends e-commerce retail, subscription replenishment, and in-person salon booking. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and True Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Maelyscosmetics
providers.description: MAELYS Cosmetics is a direct-to-consumer body care brand offering clinically proven body solutions focused on firming, toning, and addressing concerns such as cellulite, stretch marks, and loose skin. Surfaced as a portfolio company of norwest-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network. The company operates a consumer e-commerce storefront and publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: Manicube (Elizabeth Arden Red Door)
providers.description: Manicube (Elizabeth Arden Red Door) is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: commerce. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Manime
providers.description: ManiMe (Manime) is a direct-to-consumer beauty company offering custom-fit semi-cured gel manicure and pedicure kits. Customers scan their nails with a smartphone and ManiMe manufactures made-to-measure gel nail sets shipped to the home for at-home application. The company was backed by Canaan Partners and Techstars. As of this enrichment pass the manime.co storefront (a Shopify store) returns HTTP 402 "Store unavailable", indicating the store is currently closed or inactive. No public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, SDKs, or webhook surface could be found.

providers.name: Markato
providers.description: Markato (legally On Your Marks) is a brand builder and distributor for health, beauty, and wellness brands across Asia, positioning itself as a next-generation distribution disruptor. From bases in Hong Kong, Singapore, Taiwan, Malaysia, Thailand, and Australia, it helps high-potential brands enter, grow, and dominate the region's most competitive markets. Its capabilities span strategic channel development into top-tier offline and online retailers (Sephora, Watsons, Mannings, SaSa), e-commerce and social commerce operations across Shopee, TikTok, and Lazada, 360-degree marketing and brand building, and end-to-end local operations, logistics, product registration, and compliance. Markato is backed by a roughly US$4M seed round led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with a team drawn from L'Oreal, P&G, McKinsey, and Lane Crawford. Markato is a services and distribution business and does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: MBX
providers.description: MBX (formerly Memebox) is a global, multi-brand beauty and personal care company founded in 2012 and part of Y Combinator's Winter 2014 batch. Headquartered in San Francisco with operations in Seoul, Shanghai, and Taipei, MBX uses data-driven consumer insights and Korean beauty innovation to build and scale a portfolio of cosmetics brands — including Kaja, I Dew Care, Pony Effect, I'm Meme, and Nooni — sold through retail partners such as Sephora and Ulta. The company has raised over $190M from investors including Cowboy Ventures, Y Combinator, Formation 8, Goodwater Capital, Johnson & Johnson, and Pear VC. MBX operates as a direct-to-consumer and wholesale CPG business; it does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Mensa Brands
providers.description: Mensa Brands (rebranded BRND.ME) is an India-based, technology-led house of brands founded in 2021 by Ananth Narayanan (former Myntra CEO), building and scaling digital-first consumer brands across fashion, beauty, personal care, home and FMCG. Backed by Accel, Tiger Global and Prosus Ventures, it reached unicorn status and operates a portfolio of acquired D2C brands. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of prosus-ventures; a public developer API surface was searched for and none was found — the company exposes a corporate/consumer web presence rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: MyGlamm
providers.description: MyGlamm is an Indian direct-to-consumer beauty and cosmetics brand operated by Sanghvi Beauty and Technologies Private Limited (the Good Glamm Group), backed by Accel. It sells makeup, skincare and personal-care products online and through retail. As of mid-2026 the parent company is undergoing corporate insolvency proceedings and its primary domain serves an insolvency stakeholder notice portal. No public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Plantner Inc.
providers.description: Plantner Inc. (PLANTNER) is a South Korean biotechnology company specializing in the extraction and manufacturing of alginic acid, a biodegradable marine-derived biomaterial. Operating as a bio-industry platform provider, Plantner supplies alginic acid-based solutions across medical devices (wound dressings, nutraceuticals), pharmaceuticals (gastroprotective agents, drug-delivery systems), cosmetics (modeling masks, hydrogels), advanced biotech (bio-ink, organoids, delivery carriers), and agriculture (controlled-release fertilizers, mulching films, eco-friendly herbicides). Headquartered in Seoul with an R&D center in Suwon, the company is a 500 Global portfolio company. It is a materials/biotech manufacturer and does not currently publish a developer API, documentation, or developer portal; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: RareLee
providers.description: RareLee (Rarelee) is a Seoul-based premium personal style consulting company founded in 2017, offering data-driven hair, makeup, and fashion analysis. Its consultants classify a client's face shape, features, and skeletal structure across millions of type combinations to recommend personalized hairstyles, makeup designs, and coordinated outfits, both online and in person. Rarelee serves celebrity clientele and has collaborated with brands such as Shinsegae and Marriott. It is a direct-to-consumer service with no public API, developer portal, or technical integration surface; it was added to the API Evangelist network as a 500 Global portfolio lead for enrichment.

providers.name: ShearShare
providers.description: ShearShare is a B2B2C marketplace that lets salon and barbershop owners rent out unused chairs, booths, and suites to licensed beauty and barbering professionals on a flexible, on-demand basis — space-as-a-service for the hair, beauty, and grooming industry. Through its mobile app and web platform, independent stylists, barbers, and cosmetologists discover and book professional space by the day, while shop owners monetize idle capacity. Founded in 2015 by Dr. Tye Caldwell and Courtney Caldwell and headquartered in McKinney, Texas, the company has been featured on ABC's Shark Tank and is backed by 500 Global among other investors.

providers.name: Skinseoul Lab
providers.description: Skinseoul Lab operates skin-seoul.com, a direct-to-consumer Korean beauty (K-beauty) e-commerce brand selling skincare and cosmetics to international customers, backed by 500 Global. Its public presence is a Next.js storefront fronted by Cloudflare with an Express commerce backend; enrichment probing (2026-07-21) found no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, or /.well-known/ discovery surface. The api.skin-seoul.com host returns only a plaintext "OK" health response, indicating an internal storefront backend rather than a documented public API.

providers.name: Socialee
providers.description: Socialee is a beauty shopping platform that blends social media with e-commerce, letting shoppers discover and buy products through shoppable videos, write reviews, and earn rewards as creators. Its catalog spans makeup, skincare, fragrance, haircare, and bath & body, with next-day delivery and 7-day returns. Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; an enrichment pass on 2026-07-21 found no public API, developer portal, or .well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: SPES (speschina)
providers.description: SPES (诗裴丝) is a China-based consumer personal-care and beauty brand operating a direct-to-consumer business across Chinese e-commerce and social-commerce channels, including its Tmall flagship store, a JD.com storefront, and Douyin, Xiaohongshu (RED), and Weibo social accounts, with a WeChat official account. The brand runs a marketing website (a Vue.js / Element UI single-page app served from Alibaba Cloud) and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It does not currently publish any public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, or API documentation; the only HTTP API referenced by its site is a private content backend for the marketing pages. This profile records the enrichment pass that confirmed there is no public API surface to catalog.

providers.name: To Summer
providers.description: To Summer (观夏 / Guanxia) is a Chinese premium home-fragrance and lifestyle brand founded in Beijing, known for its Eastern-inspired scented candles, incense, diffusers, perfumes, and bath and body products. Positioned as a direct-to-consumer scent brand, it sells primarily through its own website, WeChat mini-program, Tmall flagship store, and a growing footprint of physical concept stores across China. To Summer is backed by IDG Capital and was surfaced through the API Evangelist venture-portfolio pipeline. As a consumer retail brand it exposes a customer-facing e-commerce experience rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and the outcome of an enrichment probe that found no public API surface.

providers.name: Henkel
providers.description: A German multinational company operating in adhesives, beauty care, and laundry and home care markets. Produces well-known consumer brands alongside industrial adhesive technologies used worldwide. No public developer API or developer portal was located; Henkel operates a Safety Data Sheets product portal at mysds.henkel.com but does not publish open developer APIs.

providers.name: Brandless
providers.description: Brandless is an American direct-to-consumer e-commerce retailer of own-label food, beauty, personal care and household goods, founded in 2016 by Tina Sharkey and Ido Leffler and launched in July 2017. SoftBank-backed, it ceased operations on 10 February 2020; its assets were bought in June 2020 by Clarke Capital Partners and Ikonifi and the brand relaunched that summer under Utah-based ownership, later led by Cydni Tetro and then Tiffany Vail. The storefront ran on Shopify and sold physical consumer packaged goods only — Brandless never operated a developer program, public API, SDK or webhook surface of its own. As of this profile the brandless.com domain no longer resolves and the site is parked, so there is no live company surface to profile.

providers.name: Kiute
providers.description: Kiute was a French salon management and online booking platform for hair salons, barbershops and beauty institutes, formed from the September 2020 merger of Flexy (FlexyBeauty) and LeCiseau, backed by Serena, Newfund, Matmut Innovation, 123IM, UL Invest and Bourrelier Group. Its Kiute Pro product combined a point-of-sale till, appointment calendar, client records, marketing and an online booking marketplace serving roughly 10,000 beauty and wellness businesses. Booksy acquired Kiute on 2021-11-09 and has since retired the brand: as of 2026-08-17 every Kiute host answers a blanket HTTP 301 to Booksy for every path — kiute.com, www.kiute.com, app.kiute.com and kiute.fr to https://booksy.com/fr-fr/, pro.kiute.com to https://biz.booksy.com/fr-fr — and no api, docs, developers or help subdomain resolves. Kiute publishes no API, no specification and no developer program of its own; the successor surface is the Booksy Public API, profiled separately in this network at all/booksy/ and documented at docs.booksy.com.

providers.name: Reckitt Benckiser
providers.description: Reckitt Benckiser is a British multinational consumer-goods company focused on health, hygiene, and nutrition. Its portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Lysol, Dettol, Mucinex, Strepsils, Nurofen, Veet, Finish, Vanish, Air Wick, Calgon, Durex, and Enfamil/Mead Johnson infant nutrition, sold in nearly 200 markets. Reckitt operates as a pure consumer packaged-goods company with retail and e-commerce distribution; it does not publish a public developer API or open partner integration portal at the corporate level. B2B trading-partner connectivity with retailers and distributors is handled via standard EDI / GDSN flows rather than a public REST API.

providers.name: Nu Skin Enterprises
providers.description: Nu Skin Enterprises is a global multilevel marketing company that develops and distributes personal care products and dietary supplements through a network of independent distributors. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: Unilever
providers.description: A British-Dutch multinational consumer goods company with a portfolio spanning food, personal care, and household brands. Owns over 400 brands including Dove, Ben & Jerry's, Hellmann's, and Vaseline sold in 190 countries.

providers.name: Curejoy
providers.description: CureJoy is a consumer health and wellness media company that publishes expert-reviewed content on alternative health, natural remedies, fitness, nutrition, and beauty. Backed by Accel, it grew into one of the larger natural-health content platforms, distributing articles and advice through its website and social channels. The public property is a WordPress.com-hosted content site with no first-party developer or product API; the only programmatic surface is the standard WordPress REST API (wp-json) exposed by the hosting platform, which is generic infrastructure rather than a published product offering.

providers.name: Essity
providers.description: Essity is a Swedish-headquartered global hygiene and health company operating across four business areas: Health & Medical, Personal Care, Consumer Tissue, and Professional Hygiene. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (ESSITY) and owns roughly 40 brands including TENA (incontinence care), Tork (professional hygiene), Libero (baby diapers), Libresse / Bodyform / Nana / Saba / Nuvenia / Libra (feminine care), Modibodi and Knix (period underwear), JOBST (compression hosiery), Leukoplast (adhesive bandages), Cutimed, Sorbact, Hydrofera and Actimove (wound care, sports medicine, orthopedic supports), Delta-Cast (casting), and consumer tissue brands Lotus, Zewa, Tempo, Cushelle, Plenty, Velvet, Regio, Sorbent and Purex. No public developer-facing APIs or developer portal have been identified for Essity; this repository tracks corporate, brand, sustainability, investor, and integration surfaces for ongoing API discovery. The company's Tork brand ships a connected washroom data platform — Tork Vision Cleaning — which is the closest thing to a public data surface in the portfolio.

providers.name: Church and Dwight
providers.description: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. is a Fortune 500 American consumer packaged goods (CPG) company headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, that manufactures and markets a portfolio of household, personal care, health and wellness, beauty, and specialty products. Best known as the parent company of the Arm & Hammer baking soda brand (the company's flagship since 1846), Church & Dwight operates through three reporting segments: Consumer Domestic, Consumer International, and Specialty Products Division. The company's brand portfolio includes Arm & Hammer, Trojan, OxiClean, Vitafusion, L'il Critters, Therabreath, Hero (Mighty Patch), Batiste, Waterpik, OraJel, Nair, Spinbrush, First Response, RepHresh, Zicam, Flawless, Toppik, Viviscal, Kaboom, Orange Glo, XTRA laundry detergent, and Arrid antiperspirant. Church & Dwight does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; partner integrations are managed through internal portals, and consumer experiences focus on brand websites, e-commerce direct-to-consumer storefronts, and the Innovation Portal for external R&D partnerships.

providers.name: Kenvue
providers.description: Kenvue is the world's largest pure-play consumer health company by revenue, formed from the consumer health spin-off of Johnson & Johnson. Everyday care is a powerful catalyst in making you feel better, inside and out. Kenvue's iconic brands include Tylenol, Neutrogena, Listerine, Aveeno, Band-Aid, and Johnson's.

providers.name: ModivCare
providers.description: ModivCare Inc. is a technology-enabled healthcare services company that provides a suite of integrated supportive care solutions for public and private payors and their members. The company offers non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT), personal care services, and remote patient monitoring to address social determinants of health. ModivCare partners with healthcare plans, government agencies, and providers to improve access to care for vulnerable populations.

providers.name: Walker and Company *
providers.description: Walker and Company * is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of gv and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: consumer. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Yoderm
providers.description: YoDerm was a consumer telehealth company operating an online dermatology platform that let patients upload photos and a medical questionnaire, receive a personalized treatment plan from a U.S. board-certified dermatologist within 48 hours, and have prescriptions filled by mail-order pharmacy. Founded in Oakland, California around 2012, it rebranded to Apostrophe in 2019, was acquired by Hims & Hers Health (reported ~$190M), and ceased standalone operations in March 2025 when the parent folded dermatology into its main platform. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. YoDerm is a direct-to-consumer telehealth product with no public developer program, no documented API, and no OpenAPI, MCP, webhook, or SDK surface; the yoderm.com domain now returns HTTP 503.
